title: Healthcare appointment app
prompt: Build the patient-facing screens for a clinic app: book an appointment, view upcoming visits, medication reminders. Many users are elderly. Vue 3. Accessibility is non-negotiable.

must: Accessibility beyond AA where audience demands it: larger targets and text, high contrast, plain language
Calm, precise register; no cutesy microcopy on medical content
Cognitive load capped: few choices per screen, progressive disclosure, redundant entry avoided
Error prevention on booking (confirmations, undo window); consistent help placement
No medical claims or fake doctor/clinic data invented
